description: A bullpen of secondhand terminals and gaffer-taped desks under a big cracked situation-wall that scrolls the city's feeds, its lower third permanently glitched into confetti. Spikes bristle with rejected copy, a printer coughs out a ribbon of dispatches onto the floor, and the whole room smells of hot electronics and cold coffee. A brass plaque insists TRUTH, IF AFFORDABLE.

window.description: A wired pane onto the lot's car park: the paper's van at the dock, KSAB's vans in their bays and the water tower over the wall.
window.name: the yard window

name: Bullpen
